author_constraints: Write a research plan, not a completed experiment report.
Keep observed_results empty and label all empirical quantities as planned targets or source-reported values.
Use only the cited sources for literature claims.
Do not add an Acknowledgment or Acknowledgements section.
Do not turn 200,000 years or 27 million years into established speech-origin dates.
Do not claim that one brain region, one gene, or one hemisphere controls speech alone.
Include mathematical definitions and explicit falsification rules.
Target an IEEE-style report of at least 7 pages without filler.
